_comment: Pokémon KB collector-nickname list (CoS order O-129 M-3, Nov 28 2026). One entry per nickname in common use for a card we price. nickname (lower case, as a visitor types it) -> card ids from data/card-search.json; first id = the default the search box returns. Names only, never a price. Every entry carries its sources (R40); a nickname without a source is not filed. Read by tools/build-search-aliases.mjs (Build Loop row M-3). Maintained by the Pokémon KB Agent; history in AUDIT-LOG-2026-11l.md + ADDENDA-2026-11l.md.

gold star umbreon.note: Default = the 2007 POP Series 5 original, Umbreon ☆ 17/17. cel21-17 is the Celebrations Classic Collection reprint of the same card and number (README #19 reprint trap); sellers call it 'Umbreon Gold Star' too. The search box returns the original first; a query with 'celebrations' should reach cel21-17.
sources: https://www.ebay.com/itm/117119081702 (PSA label wording: "2007 POKEMON POP SERIES 5 #17 UMBREON-GOLD STAR PSA 7")
https://www.ebay.ca/itm/178459607306 ("Umbreon Gold Star 17/17 … Pokemon Celebrations": the reprint carries the nickname too)

crystal charizard.why: one search (Nov 28) found the card (Bulbapedia 'Charizard (Skyridge 146)', PriceCharting) but no page using the phrase 'Crystal Charizard' for it; file on one PSA/PriceCharting/article use of the phrase

gold star <name> (other GSTAR cards).would_map: gstar-* ids whose Pokémon appears once among the 35 gstar rows (Rayquaza, Torchic, Mudkip, Treecko, Espeon, Latias, Latios …; NOT Pikachu, Charizard, Mewtwo, which appear twice)
gold star <name> (other GSTAR cards).why: PSA labels and PriceCharting use '<NAME>-GOLD STAR' / '[Gold Star]' as a convention, but only Umbreon was read card by card this run; one source line per card before filing

rayquaza alt / umbreon alt / dragonite a.why: 'alt' nicknames are ambiguous between V and VMAX alt arts (Umbreon, Rayquaza both have two tracked); need a source that names the default before filing
